title: Tables
summary: --Tables is a free-floating form subdivision under topical headings for tabular works of computed or processed results used as reference tools (not raw data, which take statistics/measurement headings). --Conversion tables is free-floating under topical headings for tables of equivalents between units. Obsolete forms --Tables and ready-reckoners, --Tables, calculations, etc., --Tables, etc., and --Formulae, tables, etc. are not assigned and are replaced by --Tables.
validation_rules: `--Tables` is a free-floating form (`$v`) subdivision under topical headings for tabular listings of computed or processed results, e.g. `Gas lasers--Tables`, `Food--Caloric content--Tables`, `Mortality--Latin America--Tables`. (H 2160 sec. 1)
`--Tables` is not for lists of raw or unprocessed data; use headings or subdivisions for statistics, measurements, observations, etc. (see H 2095). (H 2160 background)
The subdivisions `--Tables and ready-reckoners`, `--Tables, calculations, etc.`, `--Tables, etc.`, and `--Formulae, tables, etc.` are obsolete; replace with `--Tables`. (H 2160 sec. 2)
[LC practice] Do not assign the obsolete table subdivisions; replace them with `--Tables` when encountered. (H 2160 sec. 2)

`--Conversion tables` is a free-floating form subdivision under topical headings for tables of equivalents for changing units of measure or weight, e.g. `Temperature--Conversion tables`, `Time--Conversion tables`. (H 2160 sec. 3)

sections.heading: 1. General rule
sections.text:
Use the subdivision --Tables as a free-floating form subdivision under topical headings for works of the type described above. Examples:

```
650 #0 $a Food $x Caloric content $v Tables.
650 #0 $a Gas lasers $v Tables.
650 #0 $a Ellipsometry $v Tables.
650 #0 $a Photographic surveying $v Tables.
650 #0 $a Irrigation canals and flumes $v Tables.
650 #0 $a Mortality $z Latin America $v Tables.
```

sections.heading: 2. Obsolete forms
sections.text:
Other subdivisions designating tables were used in the past, including --Tables and ready-reckoners; --Tables, calculations, etc.; --Tables, etc.; --Formulae, tables, etc.

LC practice: Do not assign these subdivisions. When they are encountered in the bibliographic database, replace them with the subdivision --Tables.

sections.heading: 3. Conversion tables
sections.text:
Use the subdivision --Conversion tables as a free-floating form subdivision under topical headings for tables of equivalents for changing units of measure or weight into other units. Examples:

```
650 #0 $a Temperature $v Conversion tables.
650 #0 $a Time $v Conversion tables.
```
